acceptance: verify(dir, key, { requireEntries = false }) returns { valid: false, entries: 0, message: "empty manifest (--require-entries requires at least one entry)" } when both root manifest and manifest.d segments are empty and requireEntries is true, while continuing to return { valid: true, entries: 0 } by default.
gate-manifest verify accepts --require-entries and exits 2 via gateFail when the ledger has 0 entries, while gate-manifest verify without --require-entries continues to exit 0.
USAGE and packages/gate-manifest/README.md document --require-entries for CI checks.
title: gate-manifest: add --require-entries so verify fails closed on an absent or empty ledger (#656)
